readme: Per-item record of the third model-study leg published in docs/narrative-evidence-v1.md (Third model study). It re-runs leg 2's corpus — the same six repositories and 204 files, the same model — under PROMPT_VERSION 2 and with temperature and seed transmitted, so leg 2 and this leg form the only genuinely paired comparison in the study: same files, same model, differing only in prompt version and sampling pins. Two variables moved together, which is stated in the doc rather than glossed; the leg's own determinism result is what limits the confound, since pinning is shown not to change run-pair agreement. PROVENANCE IS WEAKER THAN LEG 2's. That leg shipped a raw run log (ds4.ndjson) and every published figure was reconciled against it independently; this leg shipped no equivalent, so its numbers are reconciled only against this file. The record is internally consistent and structurally identical to leg 1's shape, but nothing outside it corroborates that the runs occurred as described. Treat it as contributed point-in-time evidence, not as a measurement this repository can reproduce. run holds the pins: model, endpoint, prompt version, temperature 0, seed 42, and this leg's own per-repo subject commits. items holds one record per file: the verdict of each of the 3 generations, the uncited tokens the run-1 stamp names, and narrative_sha16. Two caveats carry over from leg 2. The stamp previews at most 5 tokens and items with more carry a trailing …+N marker, so token aggregates recover the total as named + N and must not use the stamp-named count alone. And --llm-refresh still rewrites one cache key per generation, so only the third narrative survives on disk: sha16 is present for generation 3 and null elsewhere, which means byte-identity across generations cannot be checked here and any token-level determinism claim is not verifiable from this record. Verdicts are complete for all three generations, so the verdict-level flip and agreement figures are. The doc recomputes all aggregates from items; this file stores no derived statistics.

run.runtime: codelore 0.29.0 binary at upstream 2067d3f (incl. #349 prompt fencing, PROMPT_VERSION 2; CODELORE_LLM_TIMEOUT_SECS env supported), driven by runners/run-eval.cjs
run.endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1 — local OmniRoute gateway (OpenAI-compatible); api key rotated per generation to bypass gateway semantic cache
